为什么人工湿地能代替一部分污水处理厂？

Why can constructed wetlands replace part of a sewage plant?

它们用植物—微生物—基质协同去污，能耗低、运维便宜，适合农村或小社区；但对高浓度污水要先预处理，不能完全取代大型厂。
They clean via plant-microbe-substrate synergy with low energy and cost, suiting villages or small communities; but strong wastewater needs pre-treatment, so they can't fully replace big plants.

湿地为什么能"自然净化"脏水？

Why can wetlands "naturally purify" dirty water?

水生植物和根系上的微生物会吸收氮磷、分解有机物，泥沙还能拦截颗粒；水慢慢流过湿地，就像过了一道免费的"生态滤池"。
Aquatic plants and their root microbes take up nitrogen and phosphorus and break down organics, while silt traps particles; water creeping through a wetland passes a free "eco-filter".

芦苇等水生植物在净水里到底起什么作用？

What exactly do reeds and aquatic plants do in water purification?

它们像"水泵+吸管"：叶片光合作用供氧，根系泌氧给微生物，同时把水中的营养盐吸进自己身体，间接带走污染物。
They act like "pumps and straws": leaves photosynthesize and oxygenate, roots leak oxygen to microbes, and they pull nutrients into their own bodies, indirectly removing pollutants.
